name: SplendorBackups – Automatic Backups for All-in-One WP Migration and Backup
author: splendorsoft

sections.description:
SplendorBackups for AI1WM / All-in-One WP Migration and Backup adds a focused scheduling layer for sites that already use All-in-One WP Migration and Backup.

The plugin can queue recurring All-in-One WP Migration exports, keep a separate list of backups created by this plugin, keep the latest completed backup in the free version, and show admin activity logs for backup starts, completions, failures, skipped runs, downloads, deletions, and retention cleanup.

It is built for site owners and administrators who want automatic backups for AI1WM / All-in-One WP Migration and Backup, scheduled backups for migration archives, and a simple way to track backup activity from the WordPress dashboard.

Backup files are stored in the standard All-in-One WP Migration backup folder:

wp-content/ai1wm-backups/

This plugin does not replace All-in-One WP Migration and Backup. It requires All-in-One WP Migration and Backup to be installed and active, and it uses that plugin’s export and backup-file handling.

Backup scheduling does not send backup files, settings, or logs to Splendorsoft or any external service. All backup files remain on the WordPress server unless an administrator downloads or moves them. The optional support form only sends the contact and diagnostic details described in the FAQ when an administrator submits it. The optional deactivation feedback form only sends the selected rating, reason, details, plugin version, AI1WM version, and locale when an administrator submits it.

Features

  • Weekly or monthly backup schedules in the free plugin.
  • Manual “Run backup now” action for administrators.
  • Keeps the latest completed backup in the free plugin.
  • Optional exclusion of spam comments and post revisions.
  • Separate admin list for backups created by this plugin.
  • Activity logs for backup starts, completions, failures, skipped runs, downloads, deletions, and retention cleanup.
  • Compatibility status panel for required All-in-One WP Migration classes, constants, and helper functions.
  • Admin-only download and delete actions protected by WordPress capabilities and nonces.
  • Upgrade option for advanced scheduling, including daily backups, custom schedules, remote storage, email notifications, backup health checks, and retention for 2 to 30 completed backups.

Support and Troubleshooting

Before relying on scheduled backups, open the Compatibility status panel and run a manual backup on the target site. If a backup does not complete, check the activity logs, the All-in-One WP Migration Backups page, the wp-content/ai1wm-backups/ folder, WordPress cron, loopback requests, disk space, and host timeout/resource limits.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher.
  • PHP 7.4 or higher.
  • All-in-One WP Migration and Backup installed and active.
  • A writable wp-content/ai1wm-backups/ folder.
  • Working WordPress cron, or a real server cron that calls wp-cron.php.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin zip from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure All-in-One WP Migration and Backup is installed and active.
  4. Go to All-in-One WP Migration > Automatic Backups.
  5. Review the Compatibility status panel.
  6. Choose a weekly or monthly frequency, start time, and cleanup options. The free plugin keeps 1 completed backup.
  7. Save the schedule.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create off-site backups?

No. Backups are local server backups stored in the normal All-in-One WP Migration backup folder. For stronger disaster recovery, copy backup files to remote storage outside the web server.

Does this plugin work without All-in-One WP Migration and Backup?

No. This plugin requires All-in-One WP Migration and Backup. If the dependency is missing or incompatible, the Compatibility status panel will show the reason.

Is this plugin affiliated with All-in-One WP Migration and Backup?

No. This plugin is an independent add-on that works with All-in-One WP Migration and Backup. It is not built by, endorsed by, or officially affiliated with the All-in-One WP Migration and Backup project.

Does this plugin send data to an external service?

Backup scheduling does not send backup files, settings, logs, or site data to Splendorsoft or any external service. If an administrator submits the optional support form, the plugin emails the entered name, email address, optional phone, optional company, query, site URL, and plugin version to support@splendorsoft.com. Support requests are not stored by the plugin.

How can I contact support or request a feature?

Open the plugin screen and use the Support and feature requests form. The form asks for your name, email address, optional phone, optional company, and query. You can also email support@splendorsoft.com directly.

Are daily backups available?

Weekly and monthly schedules are included in the free plugin. Daily backups, advanced scheduling, and retention for 2 to 30 completed backups are available through Splendorsoft premium options: https://splendorsoft.com/wordpress/plugins/splendorbackups-for-ai1wm/

Why did a scheduled backup run late?

WordPress cron depends on site traffic unless a real server cron calls wp-cron.php. Low-traffic sites may start scheduled backups late.

What does “Backup did not finish before the safety timeout” mean?

It means a backup was started or tracked, but the plugin did not observe a completion signal or final backup file before the 12-hour safety window expired. Check the activity logs, the All-in-One WP Migration Backups page, the wp-content/ai1wm-backups/ folder, and the host’s cron, loopback, timeout, disk, and resource limits.

Does uninstalling this plugin delete backup files?

No. Uninstalling removes this plugin’s settings, backup list, logs, lock state, and scheduled cron events. It intentionally preserves .wpress backup files.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Limited the free automatic backup scheduler to weekly and monthly schedules.
  • Added an upgrade panel for advanced scheduling, including daily backups, advanced retention, and other premium features.
  • Existing hourly, twice-daily, or daily free schedules are migrated to the weekly schedule.
  • Limited free retention to 1 completed backup and positioned 2 to 30 retained backups as a premium feature.

1.0.1

  • Added an admin support and feature request form with direct support email details.
  • Added optional deactivation feedback with rating, reason selection, and a skip option.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with scheduled local backups, manual queueing, retention, activity logs, compatibility checks, backup reconciliation, safety-timeout handling, admin-only download, and delete actions.
